description.value:
Whose it was. Gaspard the Uncanny, a Kyonin illusionist who tried to dimension door out. Scorch marks show where the dimensional lock caught him.

Use the standard rules for a cape of the mountebank (Core Rulebook). Its dimension door fails while the lock holds.

From the hoard of the fallen, sorted by owner and labelled in Celmak's neat handwriting.
